subject: planner: fix the issue that UnionAll didn't handle the range bump case (#52542)
summary: Planner change is narrowly scoped: `unionJoinFieldType` now uses `types.AggFieldType` so UNION/UNION ALL result types correctly perform mixed signed/unsigned integer “range bump” promotion (e.g. INT + UNSIGNED INT -> BIGINT; signed + UNSIGNED BIGINT -> DECIMAL), and the new regression test `TestIssue52472` exercises these two cases. No follow-up changes found in later history up to `origin/master` for the touched planner files.
